ticket.summary: New customer: 15-year-old garbage disposal seized solid, wants straight replacement; no leaks, no gas smell, kitchen sink otherwise usable.
ticket.customer_message: You're all set — see you tomorrow! Booked: Tue Sept 1, 3:00 PM — 27 Garnet St, Apt 1. Garbage disposal replacement, $329 flat rate including the new unit, roughly 2 hours on site. Just clear out the cabinet under the sink beforehand if you can. If anything changes (especially any new leak under there), text us back.
